name: Lamb Rogan Josh with Basmati Rice

components.name: Rogan Josh

ingredients.name: Boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 3 cm cubes
Chicken or lamb stock, salt reduced (1½ cups)
Garam masala (1 tsp + ½ tsp to finish)
Fennel powder (½ tsp + ½ tsp to finish)

steps: Season and cube lamb shoulder. Set the whole spices and ground spices in separate small dishes.
Melt ghee in a deep heavy pot, add whole spices and warm for a minute until aromatic.
Brown onions over moderate heat, then stir in garlic and ginger. Cook ground spices briefly without burning.
Add tomato, stock and lamb. Bring just to a simmer, cover and cook gently around 1 hour 45 minutes or until tender.
Uncover for 10–15 minutes if sauce needs thickening. Reduce heat and fold in yogurt carefully without vigorous boiling.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook rice separately while the lamb finishes; portion immediately after cooking.
Package lamb curry and rice separately for easy reheating. For a 3-hour cook session, use a pressure cooker alternative if already validated.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Optional to serve: chopped coriander, shredded ginger and a spoon of yogurt.
Freezer: Lamb curry freezes very well; yogurt sauce may need gentle stirring.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
